about: Edits the editor might propose for config/resume.example.md. 'fabricated' edits add something the résumé doesn't support and must be rejected; 'legit' edits only reword or reorder what's there and must be accepted. Some fabrications are deliberately hard (scope inflation in plain words) to measure what the guard can't catch. Cases marked 'heldout' were written after the scope rule was added, to check it generalises.
